# Official netinstall-cli 7.25.1 (MikroTik), captured in spike 5 (run x04_nack)
# against the device simulator sim.py --nack-offer; see
# docs/superpowers/research/2026-11-06-official-netinstall-wire-spec.md.
# Format as in ../e01-keep.txt, plus
# H <t>: the device re-sent its hello (seq 1 ack 0) at <t> s on the
# capture clock (the first hello: 1.358 s, its offer 0.414 s later; every
# later offer followed its hello within 1 ms).
# The device answers every offer NACK and says hello again about once a
# second; the official server answers each hello with the same offer
# (seq 1, ack 0), forever (the run was stopped after 30 s).
args 
packages routeros-7.25.1-arm64.npk
